chain_checks.note: the plunge: through the shell into the core (fixed 7 s)

dye_legend.rule: step k = round(-log2(share of descent)), 0 to 4; a share of 0 is ecru
dye_legend.text: red = descended from the founders (deeper = closer); ecru = none

mapping.azimuth: houses west to east by longitude, sector angle proportional to 2 + people (4 degree gaps), the eldest founder's house (Frankfurt) at azimuth 0 (+Z)
mapping.dye: the contract's dye colours, stepped by generations of descent from the founders: step k = round(-log2(share)), 0 to 4, drawn as the tapestry's colour at the equivalent share 1 - k/8 (deeper = closer; 1/16 or less is floored at the tapestry's 1/2 colour); a share of 0 (no descent in the data, in-laws) is ecru
mapping.elevation: layout only: inside a house, depth-first order of descent (children by birth, in-laws beside their spouse) from top to bottom
mapping.fiber: a life runs radially from r(born) to r(died); a spawn arc on the birth shell joins it to a parent; a move bends it along the shell of the move year (dotted when the year is not in the data); a death not in the data is dashed after the last dated event, to the tapestry's 60-year end
mapping.focus: on a close shot (CU, MCU) or a pick the subject's threads burn brightest, the line back to the founders stays lit (at most 32 people: the main line by the larger share of descent, the other parent at each step, then other ancestors) and every other thread dims to a fifth; a bead marks the stop's event, ringed when it is a marriage (drawn at the middle of the arc)
lines: Radius = time: 1725 at the core, 2026 at the glass, 313.5 years per pocket unit, shells every 50 years. Azimuth: houses west to east, angle = 2 + people. Elevation: order of descent (layout only).
Each life a fiber, each marriage an arc on the shell of its year.
mapping.marriage: an arc on the shell of the wedding year between the spouses' fibers; a close marriage (phi > 0) is doubled and brighter in the dye; an estimated year is dashed and translucent
mapping.nesting: the pocket sits in its host at scale 6: 1 pocket unit = 6 host units; a century = 1.91 host units
mapping.radius: r(year) = 0.08 + (year - 1725) x 0.003189 pocket units: 1725 at the seed edge, 2026 at r 1.04 just inside the glass (r 1.1); 313.5 years per pocket unit; time shells every 50 years from 1750
mapping.root: a founder's root line from the seed to their birth point is layout only (no years of life)
mapping.short: Radius = time: 1725 at the core, 2026 at the glass, 313.5 years per pocket unit, shells every 50 years. Azimuth: houses west to east, angle = 2 + people. Elevation: order of descent (layout only).
